title: KnowledgeAttribution
description: The E7 record of one run (HAR-97 E7, HAR-128), kept on the run's build_context step as detail.knowledge_attribution. Retrieval is not influence, so four things are traced separately: knowledge retrieved at the replay clock, judged applicable (no exception fired), used (cited by a candidate) and, for runs that also generated the same state with the DecisionGuidance withheld (arm A, the counterfactual; Config.KnowledgeCounterfactual), whether it changed a candidate, the ranking or the preferred action. `influence` is written at publish; the five deterministic E7 evals score it (contracts/evals/eval_registry.json E7.1-E7.5, gold in fixtures/orchestrator/e7_gold.json).

as_of.description: The replay clock the knowledge was read at.

retrieved.description: Everything that existed at the replay clock and was matched against the situation.

applicable.description: Retrieved knowledge whose conditions held and whose exceptions did not fire.

exception_blocked.description: Retrieved knowledge whose conditions held but an exception overrode it.

used.description: Knowledge the final candidates cite, filled at publish.

change.description: What knowledge changed about one candidate against arm A. matched: arm A produced a candidate of the same strategy_type (one without a match exists only because of the knowledge, or because arm A is a single sample).

status.description: not_run: the flag is off. compared: arm A was generated and compared. unavailable: arm A was attempted and was unusable. no_knowledge: nothing was retrieved, so arm A would equal the run.

ranking_changed.description: Some candidate's worker ranking differs from arm A's.

preferred_action_changed.description: The worker's first-ranked candidate differs from arm A's in strategy or action.

ranking.description: The worker's ranking, before core re-ranks on eval failures and the transition policy.

claimed.description: Knowledge the candidate cites as used.
